question: Should OpenClaw expose outbound delivery failures to agents as a shared system event, structured message-tool/agent delivery status, or both?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but the choice changes model-visible context, channel ownership, plugin SDK expectations, and recovery semantics.

options.title: Shared Typed Delivery Contract
options.body: Reuse durable outbound outcomes and define one agent/tool-visible contract for delivery failures before adding cross-channel behavior.

options.title: Tool And Caller Status Only
options.body: Limit the change to structured delivery status in message/agent tool results and avoid injecting new system events into session context.

options.title: Keep Narrow Channel Paths
options.body: Leave CLI, cron, restart recovery, and channel-specific handling as the supported behavior and close or defer this shared request.

recommendation.title: Shared Typed Delivery Contract
recommendation.body: Reuse durable outbound outcomes and define one agent/tool-visible contract for delivery failures before adding cross-channel behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product-boundary decision over the shared outbound/channel delivery contract, and steipete has the clearest maintainer plus implementation-history signal.
